transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um… I guess they wanted me to come in because they’ve been on me about not eating much. Most days I just have coffee before I go to the warehouse, and maybe later a yogurt or a few bites after GED class. Sitting down for a real meal just… feels like it messes everything up, what I’m trying to keep in line.
Do you find yourself avoiding eating certain foods or taking steps to prevent weight gain, like excessive exercise or skipping meals?

Yeah… I mean, I skip meals sometimes. And certain stuff, like fried food in the break room or if there’s a big plate at church, it makes me nervous. Like it’s gonna show on me right away. Then I keep thinking about it and want to check the scale.
Do you worry about gaining weight or feel like you might become fat even when others might not see you that way?
Yeah… I do worry about that. Like if I eat fried food at work, or if there’s a big plate at church, I start thinking it’s going to show on me right away. Then I just keep wanting to check the scale.
Has this worry about food and weight affected other parts of your life, like school, work, or spending time with friends and family?

I mean… I still go to work, and I still make it to GED class. But yeah, some stuff’s gotten harder. I don’t really stay for meals after church anymore, and sometimes my homework just sits there because I’m too busy trying to keep my food and my schedule… controlled, I guess.
Do you ever make yourself vomit, use laxatives, or exercise more than usual to control your weight or shape?
I… don’t really know. I don’t think so. I mean, I try to keep things under control, but… not like that, I guess.
Have you ever made yourself vomit or used laxatives to try to control your weight or shape?
I don’t… I don’t really do that. Not vomiting or laxatives. I just try to watch what I eat.
Do you ever fast or restrict your food intake for extended periods to control your weight?

Yeah… I guess I do. Most days I’ll just have coffee before the warehouse, and maybe a yogurt or a few bites later after GED class. Sitting down for a real meal just… feels like it messes everything up. The clinic’s been on me about how little it is.
Do you feel like you are overweight or need to lose weight even when others have told you that you seem too thin or that you don’t need to lose weight?

Yeah… I mean, people say I’m too thin, but I don’t really see it that way. Like if I look in the mirror before class or softball, my stomach or thighs still look… bigger than they should. And then it kind of decides whether I feel okay that day or like I messed up.
Can you tell me about the lowest weight you’ve been recently, or if you’ve noticed a change in your weight over time?

I don’t really want to say the number. It’s been going down, though. My work pants are loose, and people keep saying I look too thin… but when I see it lower, it feels like I’m finally getting somewhere. I don’t really get why everyone’s pushing me to put it back on.
Is your weight loss happening because you’re intentionally trying to lose weight or keep it low, even when others say you’re too thin?

Yeah… I mean, I guess I am trying to keep it down. Even with my pants getting loose and people saying I look too thin, when the number drops it feels like I’m doing something right. I don’t really get why everyone wants me to put it back on.
Is the main reason you restrict your eating because you're afraid of gaining weight or becoming fat?
Yeah… I think so. Like if I eat fried food at work or a big plate at church, I get scared it’s gonna show on me right away. Then I can’t stop thinking about it and I want to check the scale.
Are you avoiding eating more because of a lack of interest in food, or because of other concerns like the way food looks or tastes, rather than worries about your weight or shape?
I don’t think it’s that I’m not interested in food, or like the texture or taste. It’s more… I don’t know. I just get worried about what it’ll do to me.
